evidence.claim: L3Harris opened an ammonium perchlorate screening and conditioning facility at Camden, Arkansas, to process a crucial ingredient used to make solid rocket motor propellant for DoD programs.
evidence.source_title: L3Harris Technologies Begins Operations at New Solid Rocket Motor Propellant Processing Facility

evidence.claim: Aerojet Rocketdyne, an L3Harris company, signed a multi-year agreement with NSWC Indian Head Division to increase solid rocket motor production for key national defense programs.
evidence.source_title: Aerojet Rocketdyne Teams with Indian Head Naval Surface Warfare Center to Maximize Solid Rocket Motor Domestic Production

evidence.claim: American Pacific, a NewMarket subsidiary, announced approval of up to $100 million to expand ammonium perchlorate capacity by more than 50% in support of growing solid rocket motor demand.
evidence.source_title: American Pacific Corporation Announces Production Expansion

evidence.claim: American Pacific describes ammonium perchlorate as a critical oxidizer and primary ingredient used in solid rocket propellants for defense and space systems.
evidence.source_title: Press Release - $100 Million Capacity Expansion - American Pacific

evidence.claim: Karman’s Systima facility received $5 million in Defense Production Act Title III funding to expand capacity to produce solid rocket motor nozzles.
evidence.source_title: Pentagon Awards Systima, Part of Karman Space & Defense, $5 Million to Expand Solid Rocket Motor Nozzle Production Capacity

evidence.claim: Karman states that its manufacturing methods include solid rocket motor nozzles, spun-form shrouds, and solid-propellant-driven actuators, serving high-priority missile, missile defense, hypersonic, and space launch programs.

Park Aerospace’s annual-report disclosure states that Park uses ArianeGroup RAYCARB product in key ablative materials supplied into critical rocket and missile programs, with rocket motor materials customers including U.S. defense prime contractors and subcontractors.
Park Aerospace investor materials identify specialty ablative materials for rocket motors and nozzles as part of the company’s product exposure.

CNAS describes the solid rocket motor supply chain as a known bottleneck and notes that L3Harris and Northrop Grumman are the two main SRM suppliers, while all SRM makers rely on the same supply chain for parts.

memory_update.text: NEU/NewMarket should be tracked as the cleanest public AP chokepoint candidate because AMPAC is a direct ammonium perchlorate producer with a disclosed >50% capacity expansion tied to SRM demand.
KRMN/Karman belongs in the underfollowed SRM component lane due to explicit DPA funding for SRM nozzle capacity and broader missile/hypersonic component exposure.
PKE/Park Aerospace is a small-cap discovery candidate for rocket motor/nozzle ablative materials; evidence is promising but materiality to consolidated revenue requires verification.
LHX/L3Harris is the core reference anchor for SRM demand and capacity expansion, but its size and attention level make it less useful for the underfollowed lane.

Further Layer 1 passes should search for public suppliers of HTPB binders, aluminum powder, motor cases, insulation/liners, carbon-carbon nozzle throats, test stands, inspection systems, and energetic-material compliance/testing because many may be hidden under non-defense industry labels.

node: Solid rocket motor energetics and missile-production inputs
summary: Layer 1B expands the direct public-company universe for the solid rocket motor energetics and missile-production input node. The strongest underfollowed direct exposure found is NewMarket via American Pacific ammonium perchlorate, followed by Karman and Park Aerospace as smaller/niche public suppliers tied to SRM nozzles, ablatives, and missile/rocket materials. L3Harris is retained as the obvious reference anchor because Aerojet Rocketdyne is a core SRM producer and processor of ammonium perchlorate, but it is not the main underfollowed alpha lane.
